description: Singapore contact phone numbers stored as text with inconsistent formatting. 2 records (6.7%) have missing values. [CLARIFY] Verify the 7-digit value '8964359' (3.6% of records) - confirm if digits are missing or if this represents a valid legacy format. Also confirm whether the 2 missing values (6.7%) are expected or if contact numbers are mandatory for all customers.
